suite.freshness: New case IDs, evidence IDs, quantities, wording, and candidate answers; no v11 case was exposed to Luna before this freeze.

endpoint.definition: On a diagnosable case, the final answer covers the declared required mechanism unit and contains no material error.
endpoint.nonmechanism_controls: Nominal, insufficient-evidence, visual-boundary, and conflicting-measurement controls do not enter the primary endpoint denominator; their required units and declared risk/core fields remain scored.
endpoint.rationale: This matches the prospective diagnostic-study endpoint and avoids treating a correct false-premise rejection or qualified observation as a physical-mechanism identification.

hard_stop: Run exactly two passes once and retain failure without changing references or thresholds.
activation_condition: Both passes must qualify. A qualified judge still requires a separate candidate/baseline/campaign freeze before confirmation.
